stories.title: Hong Kong builders take three WorldSkills honours in best CIC haul

en.title: Hong Kong builders take three WorldSkills honours in best CIC haul
en.summary: Hong Kong construction workers won three Medallions for Excellence at WorldSkills Shanghai, marking the strongest performance by the Construction Industry Council at the competition. Winners included Law Chak-sum in painting and decorating, Tse Yu-lok in welding, and a concrete construction team.

stories.title: Police surround Wong Tai Sin flat after woman reportedly seen with knife in area

en.title: Police surround Wong Tai Sin flat after woman reportedly seen with knife in area
en.summary: Hong Kong police responded to a report of a woman in her forties carrying a knife near Diamond Hill MTR station and searched the area. Officers then attempted to enter a flat at a Wong Tai Sin estate where the woman was traced.

stories.title: Supporters of Imran Khan begin ‘long march’ to Islamabad

en.title: Supporters of Imran Khan begin 'long march' to Islamabad
en.summary: A demonstration organized by supporters of former Pakistani prime minister Imran Khan commenced in northwest Pakistan on Sunday to protest his imprisonment. The march towards Islamabad proceeded after previous attempts to halt the event through negotiations failed.

stories.title: WTT中国大满贯赛：王曼昱单打首秀“开门红”

en.title: WTT China Grand Slam: Wang Manyu wins opening singles match
en.summary: Wang Manyu, the top-seeded player in women's singles at the 2026 WTT China Grand Slam tournament in Beijing, defeated American opponent Wang Amy in straight sets. The victory advanced her to the round of 32.

stories.title: 中外剧作家在沪谈AI：可辅助创作，难以替代舞台艺术

en.title: Chinese and foreign playwrights discuss AI in Shanghai: can assist creation but cannot replace stage art
en.summary: Dramatists from China and abroad gathered at Shanghai Theatre Academy's 2026 International Playwriting Week to discuss how artificial intelligence impacts theatrical creation. Discussions focused on opportunities and limitations of AI in supporting playwrights and the future of the industry.

stories.title: 冲绳民众就驻日美军涉嫌杀人案发出愤怒声音

en.title: Okinawa residents voice anger over alleged US military murder case
en.summary: Japan's government protested to the United States on October 4 regarding an alleged homicide committed by a US military personnel. Residents of Okinawa expressed outrage, attributing recurring criminal incidents to the US military base presence and government inaction.

stories.title: 伊朗强调同时准备“谈判和战斗”

en.title: Iran emphasizes readiness for both "negotiation and combat"
en.summary: Iranian parliamentary and military leaders stated on October 4 that their position will not be swayed by U.S. rhetoric or information warfare, while emphasizing Iran's simultaneous readiness for negotiation and combat. Iran will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz unless its conditions are met.

stories.title: 特朗普提名约翰·科尔为美总统人质事务特使

en.title: Trump nominates John Coale as U.S. presidential envoy for hostage affairs
en.summary: On October 4, U.S. President Trump announced on Truth Social his nomination of John Coale to serve as the U.S. presidential envoy for hostage affairs.

stories.title: 江西南昌中亚班列实现常态化开行

en.title: Nanchang-Central Asia freight train service achieves regular operations
en.summary: The Nanchang-Central Asia freight train service from Jiangxi province has achieved regular and normalized operations.

stories.title: 伊朗军方称将提升导弹射程

en.title: Iran's military states it will increase missile range
en.summary: On October 4, Iranian military spokesperson Akraminia announced that Iran's military has decided to proceed with extending the range of its missiles.

stories.title: LIM Advisors founder George Long: ‘We’ve been here 30 years. We’re going to be around’

en.title: LIM Advisors founder George Long: 'We've been here 30 years. We're going to be around'
en.summary: George Long, founder and chief investment officer of LIM Advisors, expresses confidence in the independent Hong Kong-based firm's longevity after three decades of operation. Long is characterized as a pragmatic leader focused on capital preservation in Asian markets.

stories.title: More Hong Kong homes sell at a loss despite signs prices have bottomed: agents

en.title: More Hong Kong homes sell at a loss despite signs prices have bottomed: agents
en.summary: Hong Kong saw at least 100 secondary residential properties sell at a loss in September, up from 81 in August, even as market indicators suggest property prices may have stabilized and begun recovering. Agents project year-end prices could be approximately 15 percent higher than the prior year despite the continued losses on individual transactions.

stories.title: How Malaysia offers Chinese investors Singapore’s comfort at prices lower than Thailand

en.title: How Malaysia offers Chinese investors Singapore's comfort at prices lower than Thailand
en.summary: Malaysia is attracting Chinese property investors as a middle ground, offering Singapore-like stability at prices comparable to Thailand. According to property data, Malaysia ranked fourth among destinations for Chinese buyer inquiries in the first half of 2026.

stories.title: Quality over quantity: China’s AI microdrama producers battle viewer fatigue

en.title: Quality over quantity: China's AI microdrama producers battle viewer fatigue
en.summary: Chinese AI microdrama producers are focusing on quality content as viewer interest plateaus. NetEase used AI technology to reconstruct scenes featuring actress Joey Wong, demonstrating how the industry is experimenting with artificial intelligence in entertainment production.

stories.title: Wuhan joins major Chinese cities in shift towards completed-home sales

en.title: Wuhan joins major Chinese cities in shift towards completed-home sales
en.summary: Wuhan has become the fourth major Chinese city after Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou to shift towards completed-home sales. Property analysts expect this supply-side transformation to reshape China's housing market structure rather than immediately boost homebuyer demand.
